text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E after large gains felt rewarding, but later selling more at a loss reminded me not to anchor on past gains or average cost; I should reassess each holding using its current prospects and role.","Buying more Stock B after its price fell may lower my average cost, but a lower price alone is not a reason to buy; I should check the investment case and avoid adding beyond my risk limits.","My infrequent trading can leave the portfolio exposed to changing risks, so I should periodically review concentration, diversification, and cash needs even when I make no trades."]}
